'''CANTINA''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], that operated in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Air Avab]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a number of rumors arose from individuals inside CANTINA, regarding a possible conflict between the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] [[Nirama]] and [[Rufus Trammel]]. Some of the individuals claimed that Nirama's pirvate [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] had been attacked and destroyed, while others claimed that the yacht had survived and destroyed it's attackers. Some of the cantina's other patrons also claimed that the yacht had not been involved in the attack, and that two opposing groups of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] had battled each other in the shipping lanes of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].
